text:
Talia: Heads up 1: splitting the Private deploy roadmap slice into two discrete tickets: NETWORK-EDGE (egress pinning + BGP playbooks) and CUTOVER-OPS (operator fast-fallback + runbooks). Need final acceptance criteria.
Ishan: Agree. NETWORK-EDGE must include a reproducible test harness that proves egress immutability for 95% of test cases. CUTOVER-OPS needs a graceful KV eviction strategy and a metrics contract.
Meera: Field input: a lot of small customers care more about simple rollback than perfect egress. We should support both paths and provide guidance for when to choose each.
Vik: For BGP customers we'll provide a route-swap checklist. For cloud VPC, NAT-based pinning is the answer. Both require an ops lead on the call.
DocBot: New draft documents created: netops/nat-guide.md, cutover/runbook-template.md
Talia: Draft acceptance criteria suggestion:
- NETWORK-EDGE: Egress IP pinning validated by fuzz tests for common cloud flavors; documentation and ordering flow updated.
- CUTOVER-OPS: Fast-fallback toggles within 1 API call; KV grace TTL configurable per tenant; runbook with 3 dry-run examples.
Meera: Also add a customer-facing page that explains tradeoffs: minimal downtime vs preserved IPs vs extended maintenance.
CS-Lead: We need a sales play to explain costs: static NAT allocation charges + potential temporary capacity bursts.
Ishan: Engineering lead: we'll target FEATURE-BETA for Q3. If we hit performance issues, we'll degrade to opt-in pilot customers only.
Talia: Action items: Ishan own harness & metrics contract (due Fri). Vik own BGP checklist + NAT ordering flow (due Fri). Meera & CS-Lead produce field-facing tradeoff doc and sales play (due next Wed). I'll publish roadmap update once items are in.
Meera: One more: include a template for customer-run dry-run to be executed by on-call (so customers can test on their topology).
Talia: Good call. Add to runbook template. Everyone comfortable with promoted scope?
Ishan: 👍
Vik: 👍
Meera: 👍
